description: AWSIM is the Autoware Foundation's Unity-based simulator for testing automated-driving software with vehicle and roadside environments. It exposes ROS 2 messages matching vehicle interfaces and simulates dynamics, LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, IMU, traffic lights and random traffic. Inputs are scenes, scenario settings and vehicle commands; outputs are simulated sensor and vehicle-state messages. Geographic coverage is configurable, with a documented Tokyo Nishi-Shinjuku demonstration. Code is free under Apache-2.0; assets use CC BY-NC, and the licence separately restricts public hosting of the documentation. A limitation is that example performance depends on compatible Unity, ROS and GPU versions, and simulated behaviour does not establish road safety. External assets and Autoware have their own requirements. AWSIM can support road-infrastructure and vehicle-to-infrastructure digital-twin simulations, complementary to SUMO (model-sumo). Its public guide documents a complete local demonstration. No installer, map, scene archive or live vehicle was accessed.
licence: Apache-2.0 code; CC BY-NC assets; documentation public hosting prohibited
